in_flight.verified: Drive heartbeat run.alive=true on the existing lane-A A100; GPU utilization 85%, memory 11584 MiB; local CLI keep-alive remains active.
in_flight.release_policy: Do not interrupt. After both arms finish, require successful auto-collect and release_safe=true before aadp_colab.py down a.

hypothesis: Teacher-relative action margins carry useful class-boundary information that ordinary probability KL and the rejected sample-Gram loss do not transfer.

shared: same HCX 0.5B base and current_v1 length 384 serializer
same fixed session split and seed 42
same replay-last1 10000 rows and sample weights
same M8 teacher logits, ordinary alpha=0.5 KL, optimizer, and row order
paired_design.single_quality_variable: Arm 2 adds teacher top-3 true-vs-hard-negative SmoothL1 margin KD.

loss_contract.teacher_negative_selection: For each covered row, exclude the true class and take the teacher's top 3 remaining action scores.
loss_contract.margin: (true logit - selected negative logit) / T for student and detached teacher, with T=3 inherited from ordinary KD.
loss_contract.loss: Mean SmoothL1 over the three action margins and covered rows.
loss_contract.coverage: Binary ordinary KD coverage only; nonzero conditional-alpha scales are not reused as weights and replay/unmatched rows are excluded.
loss_contract.ordinary_kd: The existing alpha=0.5, T=3 KL term is unchanged.

weight_calibration.method: On the first teacher-covered batch only, compute base and unweighted margin gradients with respect to the student logits, then freeze weight = 0.10 * ||g_base|| / ||g_margin||.
weight_calibration.search: None; the ratio, top-k, split, and seed are pre-registered.
weight_calibration.resume: The calibrated weight and calibration metadata are persisted in checkpoint_state.json and must match on epoch resume.

why_not_hidden_gram: The earlier centered sample-Gram objective retained a dominating self-similarity diagonal and produced a weak biased gradient. This card uses only 14-way action boundaries and does not load the hidden cache.
default_compatibility: All new flags default to zero/off; the paired control takes the pre-existing forward, RNG, and loss path.
decision_rule: Compare arm 2 directly with arm 1 on raw, bias, and 2-stage Macro-F1 plus list_directory/read_file/grep_search/glob_pattern/web_search/lint_or_typecheck/run_tests/run_bash. Do not promote from the historical 20260709 control alone; require no material weak-class collapse before any refit.
